parameters.text:
=You are a payroll auditor. Compare this month's payroll to last month and identify anomalies.

This Month: {{ JSON.stringify($('Aggregate Current').item.json.data) }}
Last Month: {{ JSON.stringify($('Aggregate Previous').item.json.data) }}

Flag:
1. Salary changes over 20% (up or down)
2. New employees not in last month
3. Employees in last month missing this month
4. Duplicate employee entries
5. Total payroll variance over 15%

Return JSON:
{
  "total_current": 0,
  "total_previous": 0,
  "variance_percent": 0,
  "anomalies": [{"employee": "", "type": "", "detail": "", "severity": "high/medium/low"}],
  "new_employees": [],
  "removed_employees": [],
  "summary": "2-3 sentence plain text"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Payroll Anomaly Detector
Runs on 25th of every month.
Compares current vs previous month payroll from Google Sheets.
GPT-4o flags: salary spikes, missing employees, duplicates, total variance.
Urgent Slack alert if high-severity issues found.
Always sends email report to finance.
